feedback_interpretation: The preceding feedback favors local condition and loading corrections over blanket strong-solvent adjustments. It also indicates that V1 and V2 can respond differently, so the batch emphasizes paired curves and retains compact controls to limit transfer of rare tail behavior.
batch_rationale: The batch combines same-family composition and loading contrasts for m80, m92, m112, m126, m154, and m177 with broader predicted regions in multifunctional esters, heteroaromatics, and acceptor-rich scaffolds. Compact nonpolar and heavy-halogen controls constrain transfer of rare tail corrections. Together these measurements can teach smooth versus threshold-like response, distinguish V1 from V2 behavior, and improve interpolation across both broad and compact portions of the Row-distribution.
